cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

mechanism: A copies a map signal as permission without understanding it and recruits B to imagine possibility after correction shrinks options.
confusable: D103 recruits shared hope; D92 interprets relational disappointment as connection proof.
comparison: Parade route with one spectator versus hypothetical cafe customers.
seedUse: Keep B father as thin evidence to build next spectator possibility.
